scope: Account-aware service and HTTP boundary for surgery case operations

criteria.description: The smallest safe correction is to require accountId at the service boundary, preserve the existing database repository tenant predicates and forward the authenticated account from the route.
criteria.limitations: No schema, migration, provider, target or production change is authorized.

criteria.description: Focused service tests, a new surgery route test seam and existing runtime persistence callers can prove same-account compatibility and cross-account fail-closed behavior.
